description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is part of the OrangeHRM admin plugin module, specifically within the Data Transfer Object (DTO) layer, intended to encapsulate filter parameters for employee salary search queries. The class includes a set of allowed sort fields, a private property for employee number, and methods to get and set this property. It also initializes the default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: EmployeeSalarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters related to employee salary searches, including sorting and employee identification.
